title: Google IT Support Professional Certificate
description: Launch a career in IT support in 6 months. Learn troubleshooting methodology, networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP), Linux command line, Windows administration, Active Directory, and cybersecurity basics. Includes hands-on Qwiklabs and prepares for CompTIA A+ certification.

title: Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate
description: Become job-ready for data analytics in under 6 months. Learn the full data analysis lifecycle — Ask, Prepare, Process, Analyze, Share, Act. Master spreadsheets, SQL queries, R programming, and Tableau dashboards. Includes a real business capstone project and direct hiring connections.

title: Google Project Management Professional Certificate
description: Master project management — from traditional Waterfall to Agile/Scrum. Learn stakeholder analysis, risk registers, cost-benefit analysis, Gantt charts, Kanban boards, and sprint retrospectives. Includes project charters and real-world case simulations reviewed by Google PMs.

title: Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate
description: Prepare for a career in cybersecurity in 6 months. Covers security frameworks (NIST CSF), threat modeling, SIEM tools (Splunk, Chronicle), network traffic analysis with Wireshark/tcpdump, Python scripting for automation, and incident response playbooks.

title: Google Advanced Data Analytics Professional Certificate
description: Advance from data analyst to senior data analyst or data scientist. Master Python for EDA, statistics and hypothesis testing, regression modeling (linear, logistic), machine learning with scikit-learn, and executive data communication with Tableau. Includes an industry capstone project.

title: Google Business Intelligence Professional Certificate
description: Build data pipelines, data warehouses, and business intelligence dashboards. Learn SQL for ETL, data modeling (star schema, snowflake schema), and Looker Studio for self-service reporting. Design a complete BI system for a real business scenario as your capstone.

title: Google Cloud Associate Cloud Engineer Learning Path
description: Prepare for the Google Cloud ACE certification. Deploy and manage applications, monitor systems, and configure network access on GCP. Covers Compute Engine, Cloud Run, GKE, Cloud Storage, VPC, IAM, and Cloud Monitoring — with 15 hands-on Qwiklabs.

title: Machine Learning on Google Cloud Specialization
description: Learn to build, deploy, and scale ML models on Google Cloud using Vertex AI. Covers feature engineering with BigQuery ML, Kubeflow Pipelines, model monitoring, explainability, and responsible AI practices. End-to-end MLOps pipeline from data ingestion to production serving.

title: Google AI Essentials
description: Learn to use AI tools to boost productivity across your role — writing prompts, summarizing content, brainstorming, and evaluating AI output quality. Understand how AI works, its limitations, and responsible AI principles. Suitable for non-technical professionals.

title: Google Digital Marketing & E-commerce Professional Certificate
description: Become a digital marketer from scratch. Learn SEO, SEM with Google Ads, email marketing, social media campaigns, content marketing, and e-commerce strategy using Shopify. Build campaign dashboards in Google Analytics 4 and complete a portfolio-ready marketing project.
